_collection.text: Tencent is not a bad stock but unfortunately investors & funds have no confidence in Chinese stocks even though it is making money. Regulator can easily change the rule of the game and Tencent can be hit badly like Alibaba. Looking at recent technical, it may trend lower. It is still very volatile and trade short-term. Take profit whenever you see a 5-10% surge.
